sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Molecular Profiling in Asia: The Current Status and Approach》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-8】However, several barriers continue to limit widespread implementation of genetic testing in Asia, including high costs, limited reimbursement, inadequate infrastructure, lack of trained personnel, and insufficient genomic databases representing Asian populations.

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】We also highlight key challenges and propose practical solutions, including physician and patient education, expansion of trial-matching platforms, and development of region-specific genomic datasets.

evidence.text: However, several barriers continue to limit widespread implementation of genetic testing in Asia, including high costs, limited reimbursement, inadequate infrastructure, lack of trained personnel, and insufficient genomic databases representing Asian populations.

We also highlight key challenges and propose practical solutions, including physician and patient education, expansion of trial-matching platforms, and development of region-specific genomic datasets.
